concrete_inequalities: For the balanced fresh-square target family with arbitrary-dimensional outside product block and arbitrary aggregate cross coupling, ||p_Qcross||_infinity <= 4.
With arbitrary outside coupling into every original coordinate of the shared/hub bank, ||p_Qwide||_infinity <= 32 sqrt(2)/sqrt(s) < 46.

For the newest account02/B16 true near-coloop gate-failure family and any independent additional quadratic block W on disjoint cap-one coordinates, ||p_(Qgate+W)||_infinity < 211; in particular ||p_(Qgate+Z1^2+2 Z2 Z3)||_infinity < 211.
